question: Where can I get the environmental assessment decisions on energy projects in Spain, with project, developer, location, date and outcome?

answer.summary: No complete structured Spanish inventory was found. The BOE publishes state decisions. Castilla y León has an index of 5,388 ordinary EIA files (797 energy), with publication dates and no promoter or outcome. Andalucía lists granted unified authorizations. An unofficial UAM compilation of BOE records for PV and hybrid projects covers 2014–2025 (570 rows, 470 labelled favorable and 100 unfavorable). Official coverage and the latest available decisions remain unverified.
main_caveats: Environmental decisions are distinct from final construction or operating authorization.
The UAM compilation is non-official. Its description says favorable DIAs only, but 100 of its 570 rows are unfavorable; it covers PV and hybrid projects, not all energy.
The BOE API has no DIA keyword search. A full enumeration needs a day-by-day scan of the summaries, which was not run; only 2025-12-29 and 2014-11-19 were checked.
Castilla y León declares an annual update for its case index. Its BOCYL field is a publication date and its rows have no promoter or outcome.
Andalucía lists granted authorizations only, so it cannot establish the number of adverse decisions. Its first-page dates are from 2009.
BOE and SABIA are not verified as complete inventories of regional decisions, and regional gazettes outside Castilla y León and Andalucía were not searched in this pass.
answer.confidence_reason: Re-tested the BOE route, the Castilla y León index and the Andalucía list, and cross-checked the non-official compilation against two BOE texts. National completeness and most regional gazettes remain unverified.

how_to_use.example_result: Oleo Solar; Desarrollos Ibéricos Fotovoltaicos 51, SLU; Cabra, Córdoba; decision 2026-03-27; conditions imposed.
steps: Enumerate dates and call /datosabiertos/api/boe/sumario/{aaaammdd}; keep titles containing 'impacto ambiental'. The API has no DIA keyword search (checked 2026-11-18).
Open each decision and extract promoter from Antecedentes, municipality from Descripción y localización, decision date from the heading and outcome from the final conclusion.
Retain BOE identifier, publication date and decision date separately; cross-check amendments and expiry.
reading_traps: A favourable conditional environmental decision does not itself grant construction authorization.
Heading states 80.3 MW; description states 100.54 MWp and 75 MWn, which are different measures.
One project can have multiple decisions: Oleo Solar first received a 2025 screening decision requiring ordinary assessment, followed by the 2026 statement.
The BOE API returns titles only; promoter, municipality and outcome need the decision text (checked on BOE-A-2025-26970 and BOE-A-2025-26328).
Outcome wording differs: unfavourable acts say 'desfavorable'; favourable acts say 'formula declaración de impacto ambiental a la realización del proyecto'.

problems: The API has no DIA keyword search; the 29/12/2025 summary (346 items, 3 DIA) and the 19/11/2014 summary (158 items, 0 DIA) were used as checks.

history.note: State and Balearic decisions and regional indexes tested; search limit reached with coverage gaps remaining.

Re-tested the BOE route (daily summaries of 29/12/2025 and 19/11/2014; two DIA texts), the Castilla y León index (5,388 ordinary files, 797 energy; simplified 1,318, of which 176 energy) and the Andalucía list (7,203 granted). Added a non-official compilation of 570 BOE-published PV and hybrid DIA (470 favorable, 100 unfavorable). Latest data, historical series and update frequency move to partial. Closure is interrupted: the BOE API has no DIA keyword search and regional gazettes other than Castilla y León and Andalucía were not searched.
